fusions.name: Drumming Feet
fusions.desc: A rapid kick that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Trampled Under
fusions.desc: You run through the enemies ahead, dealing 14 damage to everything in a cone 5 tiles long and knocking them 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Easy Lope
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
